implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 47 HDL source files (5 systemverilog, 9 verilog, 33 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 1 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 1 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-Rygar_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENCE is the MIT License text, read verbatim -- hence MIT. Vendored third-party HDL under the repository carries its own GPL headers (e.g. https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-Rygar_MiSTer/blob/master/lib/jt5205/jt5205.v); those govern those files, not the repository as a whole. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 47 source files (5 systemverilog, 9 verilog, 33 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. The repository is archived on GitHub and no longer maintained.
